import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
im = np.array(Image.open('first_frame.png').convert('RGB'))
h,w,_ = im.shape
print(h,w)
# Find unique-ish colors; sample some key pixels
# print a coarse ASCII map based on color classes
r,g,b = im[...,0].astype(int),im[...,1].astype(int),im[...,2].astype(int)
# blue liquid mask
blue = (b>120)&(b>r+40)&(g>80)
ys,xs = np.where(blue)
print('blue bbox', xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max())
# green band
green = (g>120)&(g>r+40)&(g>b+20)
ys,xs = np.where(green)
print('green bbox', xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max())
# gray paper: low saturation, mid brightness
mx = np.maximum(np.maximum(r,g),b); mn=np.minimum(np.minimum(r,g),b)
gray = (mx-mn<25)&(mx>90)&(mx<200)
ys,xs=np.where(gray)
# cluster rough: print bbox per row region
print('gray bbox', xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max())
# dark grabber
dark = (mx<70)
ys,xs=np.where(dark)
print('dark bbox', xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max())
# bright blue grabber (saturated blue)
bblue=(b>150)&(r<80)
ys,xs=np.where(bblue)
print('brightblue bbox', xs.min(), xs.max(), ys.min(), ys.max())
EOF"
